name: Wings of Angels
source:
In the distant future, mankind has stumbled upon a new race - and diplomacy is off the table.

Follow Kenji Nakahara as he graduates the Alliance Space Force Flight Academy and ships off to first assignment on distant Gwynevere Station, accompanied by the sarcastic yet motherly Captain Tori "Sparrow" Artemis and his best friend Jack, a long-time friend turned wingman as they graduate today.

[From [url=https://erodhcandc.itch.io/wings-of-angels]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
遥远的未来，人类偶然发现了一个新的种族——但双方已经没有外交斡旋的余地。

跟随Kenji Nakahara，看他从联盟太空军飞行学院毕业，前往遥远的桂妮薇尔空间站执行第一个任务。与他同行的，是嘴上刻薄、却像母亲一样关照人的托里·“麻雀”·阿耳忒弥斯上尉，以及多年好友杰克。今天，两人一同毕业，杰克也成为了他的僚机搭档。

[摘自[url=https://erodhcandc.itch.io/wings-of-angels]Itch.io[/url]]
